by K Baraniak · 2023 · Cited by 5 — This paper presents a solution for Semeval 2023 subtask3 of task 3: persuasion techniques in paragraphs detection . hierarchical multitask neural networks
The aim of this task is to identify all persuasion techniques in each paragraph of a given news article. We use hierarchical multitask neural networks combined with transformers.

snippet:
This hierarchical approach aimed to enrich token-level, multi-label classification by first grounding the model in related propaganda and fake news tasks.
In this paper, we propose a hierarchical multi-task learning framework, which explicitly leverages task-related knowledge via the supervision of intermediate layers.
